# 00. SETUP
```{r setup}
################################################################################
# 00. SETUP
################################################################################

# Data management
library(tidyverse)
library(readxl)
library(lubridate)

# Figures
library(ggrepel)

# Options
options(scipen = 999)
theme_set(theme_classic(base_size = 13))

# Colours: NC / gains = blue, SD / losses = orange, other states = grey
col_nc <- "#2a78d6"
col_sd <- "#eb6834"
col_other <- "#a3a29c"

# Results from analysis.Rmd (synthetic-control paths and event-study coefficients)
results <- readRDS("results.rds")
```

# F1. EXPOSURE: NET ADULT ENROLLMENT CHANGE
```{r f1}
################################################################################
# F1. Net % change in adult Medicaid/CHIP enrollment since March 2023
################################################################################

f1_df <- read_excel("clean_data.xlsx", sheet = "enrollment_month") %>%
  mutate(
    month = as_date(month),
    group = case_when(state == "NC" ~ "North Carolina", state == "SD" ~ "South Dakota", TRUE ~ "Other states")
  )

f1_figure_enrollment <- ggplot(f1_df, aes(month, net_change_pct, group = state, colour = group)) +
  geom_hline(yintercept = 0, colour = "grey40", linewidth = 0.4) +
  geom_line(data = f1_df %>% filter(group == "Other states"), linewidth = 0.4, alpha = 0.6) +
  geom_line(data = f1_df %>% filter(group != "Other states"), linewidth = 1.2) +
  geom_vline(xintercept = as_date(c("2023-07-01", "2023-12-01")), linetype = "dashed", colour = c(col_sd, col_nc)) +
  scale_colour_manual(values = c("North Carolina" = col_nc, "South Dakota" = col_sd, "Other states" = col_other)) +
  labs(x = NULL, y = "Net change in adult enrollment\nvs March 2023 (%)", colour = NULL,
       caption = "Adult = total Medicaid/CHIP minus child enrollment (CMS). AZ: total enrollment (proxy).\nDashed lines: SD expansion (1 Jul 2023), NC expansion (1 Dec 2023).") +
  theme(legend.position = "top")

print(f1_figure_enrollment)
```

# F2. BOTH-DIRECTIONS SCATTER WITH KINKED FIT
```{r f2}
################################################################################
# F2. Change in Medicaid buprenorphine and overdose deaths vs net enrollment change
################################################################################

f2_df <- results$s0_change %>%
  mutate(group = case_when(state == "NC" ~ "North Carolina", state == "SD" ~ "South Dakota", TRUE ~ "Other states"))

# Kinked fits (same models as S0.2), predicted over the observed range
f2_model_bup <- lm(delta_bup ~ gain_final + loss_final, data = f2_df)
f2_model_od <- lm(delta_od ~ gain_final + loss_final, data = f2_df)
f2_grid <- tibble(net_change_2024q4 = seq(min(f2_df$net_change_2024q4), max(f2_df$net_change_2024q4), length.out = 200)) %>%
  mutate(gain_final = pmax(net_change_2024q4, 0), loss_final = pmax(-net_change_2024q4, 0))
f2_grid <- f2_grid %>%
  mutate(fit_bup = predict(f2_model_bup, newdata = f2_grid), fit_od = predict(f2_model_od, newdata = f2_grid))

f2_figure_bup <- ggplot(f2_df, aes(net_change_2024q4, delta_bup)) +
  geom_hline(yintercept = 0, colour = "grey70") +
  geom_vline(xintercept = 0, colour = "grey70") +
  geom_line(data = f2_grid, aes(y = fit_bup), colour = "grey20", linewidth = 0.8) +
  geom_point(aes(colour = group), size = 2.6) +
  geom_text_repel(aes(label = state), size = 3, colour = "grey30", max.overlaps = 20, seed = 1) +
  scale_colour_manual(values = c("North Carolina" = col_nc, "South Dakota" = col_sd, "Other states" = col_other)) +
  labs(x = "Net change in adult enrollment, Mar 2023 to 2024Q4 (%)",
       y = "Change in Medicaid buprenorphine Rx\nper 100,000 adults per quarter",
       colour = NULL,
       caption = "Change = mean 2024Q3-2025Q2 minus mean 2022Q2-2023Q1 (SDUD). Line: piecewise-linear fit, kink at 0.") +
  theme(legend.position = "top")

print(f2_figure_bup)

f2_figure_od <- ggplot(f2_df, aes(net_change_2024q4, delta_od)) +
  geom_hline(yintercept = 0, colour = "grey70") +
  geom_vline(xintercept = 0, colour = "grey70") +
  geom_line(data = f2_grid, aes(y = fit_od), colour = "grey20", linewidth = 0.8) +
  geom_point(aes(colour = group), size = 2.6) +
  geom_text_repel(aes(label = state), size = 3, colour = "grey30", max.overlaps = 20, seed = 1) +
  scale_colour_manual(values = c("North Carolina" = col_nc, "South Dakota" = col_sd, "Other states" = col_other)) +
  labs(x = "Net change in adult enrollment, Mar 2023 to 2024Q4 (%)",
       y = "Change in overdose deaths per 100,000\n(2025 minus 2022)",
       colour = NULL,
       caption = "CDC VSRR provisional 12-month-ending December counts. Line: piecewise-linear fit, kink at 0.") +
  theme(legend.position = "top")

print(f2_figure_od)
```

# F3. SYNTHETIC CONTROL PATHS (NC, SD)
```{r f3}
################################################################################
# F3. Synthetic control: treated vs synthetic
################################################################################

f3_df <- results$h2_paths %>%
  filter(!(outcome == "od_rate" & unit == "SD" & time == 2023)) %>%
  mutate(
    period = if_else(outcome == "bup_per100k", 2023.25 + time / 4, time),
    outcome_label = if_else(outcome == "bup_per100k", "Buprenorphine Rx per 100,000 adults (quarter)", "Overdose deaths per 100,000 (year)"),
    unit_label = if_else(unit == "NC", "North Carolina", "South Dakota")
  ) %>%
  select(unit_label, outcome_label, period, Treated = treated, Synthetic = synthetic) %>%
  pivot_longer(c(Treated, Synthetic), names_to = "series", values_to = "value")

f3_start <- tibble(
  unit_label = c("North Carolina", "North Carolina", "South Dakota", "South Dakota"),
  outcome_label = c("Buprenorphine Rx per 100,000 adults (quarter)", "Overdose deaths per 100,000 (year)",
                    "Buprenorphine Rx per 100,000 adults (quarter)", "Overdose deaths per 100,000 (year)"),
  start = c(2023.75, 2023.5, 2023.5, 2023.5)
)

f3_figure_sc <- ggplot(f3_df, aes(period, value, linetype = series)) +
  geom_vline(data = f3_start, aes(xintercept = start), colour = "grey50", linetype = "dotted") +
  geom_line(colour = "grey15", linewidth = 0.8) +
  facet_wrap(outcome_label ~ unit_label, scales = "free_y", ncol = 2) +
  scale_x_continuous(breaks = 2015:2025, labels = c("2015", "", "2017", "", "2019", "", "2021", "", "2023", "", "2025")) +
  scale_linetype_manual(values = c(Treated = "solid", Synthetic = "dashed")) +
  labs(x = NULL, y = NULL, linetype = NULL,
       caption = "Proportional synthetic control (fit on % deviation from own pre-period mean); donors = no expansion change 2018-2025, middle tertile of unwinding loss.\nDotted line: expansion start. SD deaths: 2023 (transition year) omitted.") +
  theme(legend.position = "top")

print(f3_figure_sc)
```

# F4. EVENT STUDIES
```{r f4}
################################################################################
# F4. Event studies: coefficient per pp gained and per pp lost (fixed 2024Q4 exposure)
################################################################################

f4_bup <- results$h3_bup_es %>%
  mutate(
    direction = if_else(str_detect(term, "gain_final"), "Per pp gained", "Per pp lost"),
    rel = as.numeric(str_extract(term, "(?<=rel_q::)-?\\d+"))
  ) %>%
  bind_rows(tibble(direction = c("Per pp gained", "Per pp lost"), rel = -1, Estimate = 0, `Std. Error` = 0))

f4_figure_es_bup <- ggplot(f4_bup, aes(rel, Estimate, colour = direction)) +
  geom_hline(yintercept = 0, colour = "grey60") +
  geom_vline(xintercept = -0.5, colour = "grey60", linetype = "dotted") +
  geom_pointrange(aes(ymin = Estimate - 1.96 * `Std. Error`, ymax = Estimate + 1.96 * `Std. Error`),
                  position = position_dodge(width = 0.5), size = 0.3) +
  scale_colour_manual(values = c("Per pp gained" = col_nc, "Per pp lost" = col_sd)) +
  labs(x = "Quarters since 2023Q2 (ref = 2023Q1)", y = "Buprenorphine Rx per 100,000 adults", colour = NULL,
       caption = "Gain coefficients are identified by NC and SD only; 95% CIs cluster-robust by state.") +
  theme(legend.position = "top")

print(f4_figure_es_bup)

f4_od <- results$h3_od_es %>%
  mutate(
    direction = if_else(str_detect(term, "gain_final"), "Per pp gained", "Per pp lost"),
    year = 2023 + as.numeric(str_extract(term, "(?<=rel_y::)-?\\d+"))
  ) %>%
  bind_rows(tibble(direction = c("Per pp gained", "Per pp lost"), year = 2022, Estimate = 0, `Std. Error` = 0))

f4_figure_es_od <- ggplot(f4_od, aes(year, Estimate, colour = direction)) +
  geom_hline(yintercept = 0, colour = "grey60") +
  geom_vline(xintercept = 2022.5, colour = "grey60", linetype = "dotted") +
  geom_pointrange(aes(ymin = Estimate - 1.96 * `Std. Error`, ymax = Estimate + 1.96 * `Std. Error`),
                  position = position_dodge(width = 0.4), size = 0.3) +
  scale_colour_manual(values = c("Per pp gained" = col_nc, "Per pp lost" = col_sd)) +
  labs(x = NULL, y = "Overdose deaths per 100,000", colour = NULL,
       caption = "Reference year 2022. Gain coefficients identified by NC and SD only; 95% CIs cluster-robust by state.") +
  theme(legend.position = "top")

print(f4_figure_es_od)
```

# F5. GAIN VS LOSS SLOPE COMPARISON
```{r f5}
################################################################################
# F5. Slope per pp gained vs mirrored slope per pp lost
################################################################################

f5_df <- results$h3_symmetry %>%
  transmute(
    outcome = if_else(outcome == "bup_per100k", "Buprenorphine Rx per 100,000 adults", "Overdose deaths per 100,000"),
    gain_est = b_gain, gain_se = sqrt(v_gain),
    loss_mirror_est = -b_loss, loss_mirror_se = sqrt(v_loss)
  ) %>%
  pivot_longer(-outcome, names_to = c("slope", ".value"), names_pattern = "(gain|loss_mirror)_(est|se)") %>%
  mutate(slope = if_else(slope == "gain", "Per pp gained (b_gain)", "Minus per pp lost (-b_loss)"))

f5_figure_slopes <- ggplot(f5_df, aes(est, slope, colour = slope)) +
  geom_vline(xintercept = 0, colour = "grey60") +
  geom_pointrange(aes(xmin = est - 1.96 * se, xmax = est + 1.96 * se), size = 0.4) +
  facet_wrap(~outcome, scales = "free_x", ncol = 1) +
  scale_colour_manual(values = c("Per pp gained (b_gain)" = col_nc, "Minus per pp lost (-b_loss)" = col_sd)) +
  labs(x = "Effect per percentage point of net adult enrollment change", y = NULL,
       caption = "Mirror-image symmetry = the two estimates coincide. 95% CIs cluster-robust by state.") +
  theme(legend.position = "none")

print(f5_figure_slopes)
```

# F6. MONTHLY OVERDOSE TIMING (12-MONTH-ENDING)
```{r f6}
################################################################################
# F6. 12-month-ending overdose deaths per 100,000: NC, SD, other states
################################################################################

f6_pop <- read_excel("clean_data.xlsx", sheet = "deaths_year") %>% select(state, year, pop_total)

f6_df <- read_excel("clean_data.xlsx", sheet = "deaths_month") %>%
  mutate(month = as_date(month), year = year(month)) %>%
  filter(month >= as_date("2019-01-01")) %>%
  left_join(f6_pop, by = c("state", "year")) %>%
  group_by(state) %>%
  fill(pop_total) %>%
  ungroup() %>%
  mutate(
    od_rate_12m = 100000 * od_deaths / pop_total,
    group = case_when(state == "NC" ~ "North Carolina", state == "SD" ~ "South Dakota", TRUE ~ "Other states")
  )

f6_figure_monthly <- ggplot(f6_df, aes(month, od_rate_12m, group = state, colour = group)) +
  geom_line(data = f6_df %>% filter(group == "Other states"), linewidth = 0.3, alpha = 0.5) +
  geom_line(data = f6_df %>% filter(group != "Other states"), linewidth = 1.2) +
  geom_vline(xintercept = as_date(c("2023-07-01", "2023-12-01")), linetype = "dashed", colour = c(col_sd, col_nc)) +
  scale_colour_manual(values = c("North Carolina" = col_nc, "South Dakota" = col_sd, "Other states" = col_other)) +
  labs(x = "12-month period ending", y = "Overdose deaths per 100,000\n(12-month-ending)", colour = NULL,
       caption = "CDC VSRR provisional counts; each point sums the prior 12 months, so changes appear smoothed and delayed.") +
  theme(legend.position = "top")

print(f6_figure_monthly)
```
